task_description: Build Phase 3 of NEXUS: External Agent Adapters and Integration Layer. Implements concrete agent runtime adapters (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, Claude Code, HTTP, MCP), adapter registry/factory, agent identity system (soul/persona), workflow orchestration (company flow and task flow), demo configuration (NexusCorp with 5 agents and 3 scenarios), and API routes for adapters/workflows/identity.
